scope: Same present freight truck returns its original remaining aboard goods. Warehouse reload and staging are separate future increments.
acceptance: Delivery details quote actual aboard quantities, original paid goods prices and retained transport fee; explicit confirm defaults to Keep delivery.
Confirm revalidates session, same truck and exact quote before any mutation.
Ledger atomically releases only this service's uncollected claims and reserves original aboard stock for return; foreign claims reject without partial mutation.
New unloading stops; collected loads deposit normally; uncollected onboard workers physically reverse their committed ingress corridor to the rear exit.
Existing door/ramp closure and road traffic move the same carrier out; actual exit transfers ownership of the same cargo identities and awards goods-only refund once.
Free/debug goods never generate a refund; debug delivery explicitly abandons pending return without refund.
Convoy member clears only after returned vehicle exits. No new polling, animation or local engine run.
